headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 20, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a 4-1 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense. In the American League, the Cincinnati Reds dominated the New York Yankees, securing a 10-2 victory, while the Toronto Blue Jays took down the Chicago Cubs 8-6. In the National League, the San Diego Padres secured a 6-4 victory over the Texas Rangers.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries. Adley Rutschman of the Baltimore Orioles has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion, effective retroactive to June 19, 2026. The Los Angeles Dodgers have placed Blake Treinen on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. The Boston Red Sox have placed Isiah Kiner-Falefa on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 19, 2026, due to left forearm inflammation. The Athletics have placed Mark Leiter Jr. on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 18, 2026, due to right hip impingement. The Arizona Diamondbacks have placed Michael Soroka on the 15-day injured list due to a left glute strain and Jordan Lawlar on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. Ryne Nelson has also been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 16, 2026, due to a strained right elbow. Michael Helman of the Texas Rangers has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right finger fracture.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. The Chicago Cubs have acquired Jayden Murray from the Houston Astros in exchange for first baseman Cameron Sisneros. The Arizona Diamondbacks have traded shortstop Luis Urías to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. The Atlanta Braves have traded right-handed pitcher Hunter Stratton to the Pittsburgh Pirates for catcher Joey Bart. The Seattle Mariners have traded right-handed pitcher Randy Dobnak to the Kansas City Royals for cash.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down White Sox 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 4-1 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Dillon Dingler leading the offense. Dingler hit a home run (17) on a fly ball to center field.

top_news.title: **Reds Rout Yankees 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds dominated the New York Yankees, securing a 10-2 victory. Sal Stewart led the Reds' offense with 2 hits and 6 RBIs, while Will Warren pitched 5.2 strong innings with 8 strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Cubs 8-6**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured an 8-6 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Jeff Hoffman earning the win. Daulton Varsho led the Blue Jays' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Rangers 6-4**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a 6-4 victory over the Texas Rangers, with Manny Machado leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 5 RBIs. Walker Buehler pitched 5.1 strong innings, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Rutschman Lands on 7-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Baltimore Orioles catcher Adley Rutschman has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion, effective retroactive to June 19, 2026.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Jayden Murray in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have bolstered their roster with the addition of right-handed pitcher Jayden Murray, acquired from the Houston Astros in exchange for first baseman Cameron Sisneros. Murray joins the Cubs' pitching staff.
